i.norm: The DP table has (left.length+1) rows and (right.length+1) columns. Row 0 and column 0 are the base-case zeros; subsequent cells encode LCS lengths. For left="ab" and right="abc": row 0 (base): [0, 0, 0, 0] row 1 ('a'): [0, 1, 1, 1] -- 'a' matches right[0] row 2 ('b'): [0, 1, 2, 2] -- 'b' matches right[1]
